_comment: Copy this file to backends.json (gitignored) and edit. Each key is a --backend name. base_url is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the secret is read from the env var named by api_key_env (leave api_key_env off for a local endpoint that needs no key). max_tokens defaults to 400000; MOST endpoints cap output far lower (DeepSeek ~8192) and will reject or clamp a large value — lower it per model if requests fail. Run: rayman-evals --backend deepseek
